title: dev.qory.run.registered
description: The server accepted the run's registration. The gateway writes it in its own record once the registration is accepted, as the record's first event, sequence 1, with the workspace and the node discovery listed, the instance id the registration was signed with, and the values the registration announced. It is in the record alone and never posted: the server has its values from the access key and the registration. A run with no server has none.

workspace.description: The run's workspace: the id of the one workspace discovery's workspaces lists, ws_ followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters. It is Qory Apiary's workspace, not the directory a run works in.

node_id.description: Discovery's node_id: the id of the access key's node, nd_, or node pool, np_, followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

instance_id.description: The registration's instance id, signed into it, exactly as its X-Qory-Instance-Id header carried it.

forager_version.description: The registration's forager_version: the Forager module version, as Go stamps it.

events.description: The registration's events: the event types the server receives, as its configuration lists them.

contract_version.description: The registration's contract_version: the revision of this contract Forager implements, the same integer as the X-Qory-Contract-Version header.

interval_seconds.description: The registration's interval_seconds: the heartbeat interval the run uses, in seconds.
